items.text: Coffee rationing began in the United States on November 29, and gasoline rationing began on December 1.
items.question: Who in your family kept the ration books once coffee and gasoline were rationed, and what did your house cut back on?
source_quote: November 29 – Coffee rationing begins in the United States.
December 1 – Gasoline rationing begins in the United States.

items.text: The St. Louis Cardinals beat the New York Yankees, 4 games to 1, to win the World Series.
items.question: Who in your family followed the World Series between St. Louis and New York, and where did you listen to the games?
items.source_quote: October 5 – The St. Louis Cardinals defeat the New York Yankees, 4 games to 1, to win their 4th World Series Title.
